services.value: The IAWWTF provides municipal wastewater treatment, including preliminary screening, grit removal, primary clarification, biological treatment, physio-chemical phosphorus removal, disinfection (using chlorine bleach), and de-chlorination. It also treats trucked wastes such as septage, landfill leachate, municipal sludge, airport deicing fluid, and alkaline hydrolysis liquid waste from the College of Veterinary Medicine.
